name: votesphere-fullstack
description: Secure Local Real-Time Voting & Rating System with React Frontend, Python Flask Backend, TOTP dynamic passcodes, and anti-cheat tab-switching protection.

scripts.postinstall: (pip install -r backend/requirements.txt --target backend/libs || pip3 install -r backend/requirements.txt --target backend/libs) && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build: (pip install -r backend/requirements.txt --target backend/libs || pip3 install -r backend/requirements.txt --target backend/libs) && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
